name: r_surface_007.dialogue_curses
description: Source-bound curses dialogue-response route.  A disposable named NPC opens CDDA's ordinary dialogue loop with duplicate labels and one visible disabled response before response-ID proof begins.

steps.label: setup_spawn_disposable_dialogue_speaker
steps.expected_visible_fact: A source-owned debug fixture creates one nearby NPC whose ordinary dialogue contains duplicate visible labels and one disabled response.

steps.label: r_surface_007_curses_dialogue_witness
steps.objective: Select the source-advertised native talk target, then settle the R-SURFACE-007 curses charter only through advertised response IDs.
proof_targets: fresh curses dialogue descriptor with speaker identity, response text, enabled state, and response-owned stable IDs
duplicate-label responses are distinguished by IDs
wrong-speaker, missing, regenerated, disabled, index, and hotkey controls reject without transition
an advertised dialogue.choose ID produces its exact receipt and real successor topic or nested native confirmation
accepted cleanup; fixture entry receives zero feature credit
invariants: resolve every target only from this run's current descriptor
do not use hotkeys, indices, raw keys, labels as identity, screenshots, fallback, or direct mutation after setup
fixture manufacture, startup, and dialogue entry receive zero feature credit
stop on binding drift, missing receipt, retargeting, unsupported child action, or cleanup failure
